summary: Frontend-only test at 390x844 of Route Planning 'View planned route...' (Stops/Map tabs, StopsMap pins/lines/miles/Prepare boxes, persistence) and the Add Leg 'Set Now' buttons, on the pro boat (toast path) and admin boat (list navigation path). All 7 requested features pass. No functional bugs found.

issues: On short legs the .stop-prepare box (placed 82% along the leg) overlaps the stop pin, its tooltip and the next leg's .stop-miles label (e.g. 'Prepare to return to Dock' covered pin 4 and the '4.2 nm' label). Could offset it to one side of the line or hide it at low zoom.
The map always centres on GPS even when every pin is already placed, so pins away from the boat start off-screen (pro boat: stop 2 was off the map). Could fitBounds to the pins when they exist.

passed_tests: view-planned-route-btn is the next sibling after add-leg-btn; opens trip-view-dialog titled 'Planned route', Stops tab active by default, Map tab inactive

Stops tab: trip-confirm-leg/depart/arrive-{n} for Route Plan + each leg; prepare-{n} only when the leg has an arrive type ('Prepare to anchor'); trip-confirm-miles-{n} shown only when both pins are set (6.4 nm, then 16 nm / 13 nm after re-pinning; 3.9/3.7/4.2 nm on admin)
Map tab: Leaflet canvas centred on granted GPS (-41.28,174.78) with a boat-dot; 12 tiles loaded from tile.openstreetmap.org + tiles.openseamap.org

Default selection is the first unpinned stop; tapping the map drops a pin and auto-selects the next unpinned stop (0->1->2->3 on admin); selected row has aria-pressed=true + amber border and the pin gets .route-pin-picked

stops-map-stop-{i}-status shows 'x.x nm'/'NN nm' + pin icon (stop 0 shows only the icon), 'Tap the map' for the selected unpinned stop, empty for others; stops-map-clear-{i} only shows for the selected pinned stop and clears the pin along with its line and miles
Dashed polylines (stroke-dasharray '8 6'), a .stop-miles label per leg, a .stop-prepare box only for legs with an arrive type (Berth/Anchor/Dock)

Map .stop-prepare closes the dialog: on the pro boat a toast 'This boat has no Arriving at Destination list yet...'; on the admin boat anchor opens 'Arriving at Destination', dock opens 'Returning to Dock'; Stops tab trip-confirm-prepare-1 opens Arriving at Destination
Pins persist in weather.start_pos/dest_pos/legs[i].dest_pos (checked in Mongo) and show again after closing, reopening and reloading the page
Regression: saving a Returning to Dock leg opens trip-confirm-dialog ('Trip plan', no tabs, 'Looks good', '3 legs, back at the dock'); saving an anchor leg does not open it
Add Leg: leg-depart-now-btn sets now-15 min (08:05 at 08:20) and focuses leg-depart-at-time-input; leg-finish-now-btn sets now+2h (10:20) and focuses leg-finish-at-time-input
action_items: Optional polish: keep .stop-prepare from covering pins and miles labels on short legs
Optional: fitBounds to the placed pins when the map opens and all or most stops are pinned
critical_code_review_comments: StopsMap: once every stop is pinned the selection falls back to stop 0 (Math.max(0,-1)), so a stray tap on the map silently moves the START pin. Consider having no selection (pick=-1) when all stops are pinned and ignoring map taps until the user picks a stop.

PlannedLegs.place builds the new legs array from the closure's legs. This is fine with the current synchronous mutate, but two quick taps before a re-render could lose one leg pin; a functional updater would be safer.
Leg ids from Date.now() are stored as Int64 in Mongo; harmless, just noting it.

Restored afterwards from the backup /app/tests/backup/weather_backup_181.json (admin weather={}; pro weather back to its pre-test state, which still includes the main agent's smoke-test start_pos/dest_pos, legs=[]; route_start/route_dest='').

Leaflet layers are queried as .route-pin/.stop-miles/.stop-prepare/path[stroke-dasharray] inside the canvas. The admin boat has the arrivingDest/returningDock lists and the pro boat does not (toast). Back up user_boats.boat.weather (owner_id test-user-pro/test-admin-1, boat_id main) and restore it afterwards (restore script: /app/tests/backup/restore.js).
